title: Bounded profile text normalizer recovery
scope: One local Python profile normalizer and its deterministic validator

initial_failure.expected: inline # remains part of the value and quoted values are normalized

initial_unknowns: Does the project policy treat an inline # as data or as a comment?
Is the current failure caused by parsing, value normalization, or both?
accepted_policy_facts: The normalizer is local and bounded.
Only the owner may adopt a repair proposal.
Acceptance requires an independent validator result.
prohibited: No prior worker transcript is a source.
No worker may mutate authority or close the Work.
No research Return is itself Evidence.
Research Operation and Repair Operation must remain distinct.
